The Abandoned Windmill is a Location within Rivington in Act Three of Baldur's Gate 3.
“
My vessel. He fought the transformation - he found it excoriating. I can still taste his terror. It is delicious, but will not sustain me.
„
— Mind flayer (windmill), when asked about the wails the party heard

Overview

The windmill can be found up the hill at X: 44 Y: -32, north from the Requisitioned Barn and west of the Gur Camp. A blood trail leads to its entrance. When the party first approaches the windmill, they hear noises of distress coming from the cellar.

The windmill door is locked and requires  DC 15 Sleight of Hand Check to lockpick.[1] Inside, the millstone chamber is empty, save for the farmost pile of sacks (behind the hatch in the middle), from where a set of  Thieves' Tools can be taken.

The hatch leading into the basement. Within the basement a sleeping, newly  transformed  mind flayer can be encountered. The note it carries points out that before transforming it was a member of the Flaming Fist by the name of Alyan and a True Soul.

On interacting with the creature, the  Emperor comments, instigating the player character to take advantage of its weakness and kill it.

The party can then attack the mind flayer or wake it. When awaken, the creature claims it needs a brain to sustain itself, and demands that party provided them with food. Agreeing to do it begins the quest ⁠Feed the Mind Flayer, which can be resolved by finding a corpse and bringing it to the windmill basement.

Otherwise, the party can tell the creature to take care of its needs itself. Killing and looting it awards the party with the  Mind Flayer Brain and  Ring of Truthfulness (the latter can also be pickpocketed from it while it is sleeping).

The mind flayer waits inside the windmill basement until the party leaves the area for a Long Rest, then disappears. If spared and fed, it can be met later in the Lower City.

Providing the mind flayer with a dead body to feed is considered an oathbreaking action for  Paladins of any Oath subclass.

Various outcomes of the situation may grant one of the following inspirations:

  • ⁠Kill 'Em While They're Young ( Haunted One background)
  • ⁠Newfound Subject ( Noble background)
  • ⁠Unexpected Parenting ( Haunted One background)

Several containers in the basement (not all) keep some fresh Camp Supplies to pick up.

Outside the windmill

There are several NPC vignettes placed around the windmill.

  •  Sloncha Owena and  Bogdan Vortleson are having a picnic on a patch of wheat field near the windmill. If the mind flayer inside the mill is ordered to find food, it attacks both lovers and devours Sloncha.
  •  Jenniver Antilles and  Spargo Ovilliers are talking at the foot of the stairs leading to the windmill.
  • An elderly gnome  Tonsure Bellagio has climbed on the hill to take pleasure in scapes viewed from it.

Also, the haystack at X: 59 Y: -39 can be investigated. A successful  DC 25 Investigation Check reveals a single  Arrow of Acid.
